subject.title: [Bug]: Preflight compaction failure permanently locks Composer into "terminated" state

question: Should this issue be resolved by the narrowed gateway retryability contract, a UI lifecycle recovery safety net, or both?
rationale: Current main is source-reproducibly broken, but the acceptable policy boundary is maintainer-owned because skipping too many compaction failures can mask auth and request-shape errors.

options.title: Adopt narrowed gateway contract
options.body: Select or consolidate a linked PR that skips only timeout, 429, and 5xx preflight compaction failures while preserving 400/401/403 terminal behavior and requiring real behavior proof.

options.title: Prefer UI recovery safety net
options.body: Keep preflight compaction failures terminal but make `chat.dispatch-error` restore the Composer with an actionable user-visible error when this pre-run path fails.

options.title: Require both layers
options.body: Land the narrowed gateway policy and add UI recovery if maintainers want defense in depth for unexpected preflight failures.

recommendation.title: Adopt narrowed gateway contract
recommendation.body: Select or consolidate a linked PR that skips only timeout, 429, and 5xx preflight compaction failures while preserving 400/401/403 terminal behavior and requiring real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They gave the prior concrete retryability-contract feedback and validated the related compaction work.
